|gr1= Unit Inventory

|descr= Assigns existing item from inventory (uniform, vest, backpack) to a correct slot. If the slot is occupied by another item, it gets replaced. See also [[linkItem]].

|p1= unit: [[Object]]

|p2= item: [[String]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>

bluforUnit assignItem "NVGoggles";
opforUnit addItem "NVGoggles_OPFOR";
opforUnit assignItem "NVGoggles_OPFOR";
independentUnit addItem "NVGoggles_INDEP";
independentUnit assignItem "NVGoggles_INDEP";
</sqf>
